newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher axes 1,200 jobs in shake-up.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher axes 1,200 jobs in shake-up.

text.p: Retailing group Kingfisher Plc announced plans on Friday to axe 1,200 jobs under restructuring of two business divisions with the aim of raising profits at its Comet electrical retail chain.

The group will close 28 Norweb retail stores, selling electrical goods, and 26 Comet stores. The group said it would upgrade its Comet out-of-town stores, raising the nationwide number to 250 from 225.
Kingfisher said Comet would go ahead with plans announced by Norweb last year to close all the chain's high street shops at the beginning of March.
A further 26 Norweb retail stores in locations new to Comet will become Comet stores, Kingfisher said in a statement.
Norweb's total workforce before the job cuts numbers about 2,800.

"This acquisition is a good strategic move and will provide Comet with a significant number of first class retail locations and experienced people," said Kingfisher chief executive Sir Geoffrey Mulcahy.
